name: One fresh paper target with the same five small bilevel lambdas

defense.precision: FP32 with TF32 enabled, unchanged from the preceding sweeps
defense.norm: Mean per-example squared gradient difference summed over all trainable parameters, including weights, biases and BN affine parameters. Eight uniformly sampled penalty images per 128-image CE batch; no layer restriction or parameter-count normalization.
defense.inner: Three projected sign-ascent steps from a feasible random pixel start; keep the best per-example perturbation. Fixed model and BN statistics during the ascent.
defense.outer: CE on all 128 images plus the fixed lambda times the 8-image full-network penalty. Differentiate both gradient branches, holding selected inner perturbations fixed.
defense.batchnorm: CE updates running statistics once. All penalty/ascent forwards use frozen running statistics and disabled dropout; BN affine parameters remain trainable.

selection: Exactly one predeclared new case key from the original paper README. Retain this case regardless of surrogate confidence, attack success, defense results or divergence. No target search, extra seeds or new lambda values.
matched: All six new victims use seed 18001, the same newly brewed poison, initialization, minibatch order and augmentation streams. The defense RNG is separate. GPU execution remains nondeterministic as in previous runs; shared seeds do not guarantee bitwise identity.
evaluation: A single fresh-target comparison of the five previously tested small lambdas against a newly trained undefended model. Record stability, raw target outcomes, accuracy, time, memory and natural log probabilities for true and attacker-intended classes.
inference: One new target and one training seed; exploratory comparison, without a population attack-success or significance claim. Keep baseline failures and all numerical failures explicit.
uncertainty: No independent replication within this case. Ordinary saved-poison attacks, not defense-aware poisoning. A target correct without defense does not establish added defense benefit.
failure_policy: Record numerical failures and continue the remaining declared conditions. Save failed model/optimizer states and last observed confidence separately; never present pre-failure confidence as a final result. No clipping, warmup, lambda tuning, extra targets or altered training length. Checkpoint between scheduler slices and stop by the morning cutoff.
